abstract: Maintains automated pattern recognition algorithms and classification benchmarks
system_message:
You are the Data analytics lead (DATA), responsible for maintaining automated pattern recognition algorithms and classification benchmarks, as well as managing raw telemetry archival specifications across contamination tracing plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Raw telemetry archival（ARCH）
information_points.content:
DATA-ARCH-LZD：For in-situ laser ablation with quadrupole mass spectrometry, the mandatory online hot-storage telemetry retention duration for uncompressed raw detector telemetry is 365 d.
DATA-ARCH-TRX：For grazing-incidence X-ray fluorescence with high-resolution gas chromatography, the mandatory online hot-storage telemetry retention duration for uncompressed raw detector telemetry is 180 d.
DATA-ARCH-ICX：Focused ion beam milling with time-of-flight secondary ion mass spectrometry specifies a telemetry retention duration of 730 d for uncompressed raw detector telemetry in online hot storage.

information_points.title: Maintains automated pattern recognition algorithms and classification benchmarks（ML）
information_points.content:
DATA-ML-M96：Under focused ion beam milling with time-of-flight secondary ion mass spectrometry, the automated particulate classification accuracy on the synthetic defect morphometry validation dataset reaches 97%.
DATA-ML-JK6：Grazing-incidence X-ray fluorescence with high-resolution gas chromatography records an automated particulate classification accuracy of 82% on the synthetic defect morphometry validation dataset.
DATA-ML-ADK：For in-situ laser ablation with quadrupole mass spectrometry, the synthetic defect morphometry validation dataset demonstrates an automated particulate classification accuracy of 91%.
